platform: Cloud Linux CPU only; not RTX4060 or CachyOS

before.scenario: Frozen GUI 48-token GGUF smoke concurrently with frozen hardware CPU/Auto 32-token tests; GUI failed its 180-second smoke deadline.

after.scenario: Local prototype frozen GUI/hardware workloads concurrently, with threads4/batch4/poll0; both passed. The local CPU engine build is not byte-identical to the CI baseline.

limitations: Single warm-cache observations; scheduling uncontrolled, workloads/build contexts differ. This is evidence of the restricted-CPU regression, not a general speedup claim. Final canonical CI binaries must also pass the overlapping workload; see validation report. Unrestricted thread selection is preserved.

same_ci_engine_source_test.scenario: Two concurrent source-API CPU32 jobs using the CPU binary extracted from the baseline CI AppImage; both passed. Different workload from the GUI/acceptance overlap.
